note: Item codes are the .sav column names, unchanged by data/ecuador_2011_safety.do (Table 3 trend, local survey_cols I55 I56). The .sav variable labels tie each code to the form question: I55 = "I55. ?Cree Ud. que de septiembre 2010  En este barrio" (q.5.5, barrio), I56 = "I56. ?Cree Ud. que de septiembre 2010  Ciudad" (q.5.6, ciudad), 2/2. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.6 (section V. PERCEPCION DE LA INSEGURIDAD PUBLICA, q.5.5 and q.5.6), checked against the rendered page image, not the terse .sav labels; item_text is each question's own stem with the form's closing ellipsis, line breaks joined and the image's extra inter-word spaces collapsed (pdftotext reads single spaces); the interviewer line MARQUE UN SOLO CODIGO is not shipped; no shared instructions (the two stems differ only in barrio/ciudad and este/esta, so each carries its own stem, as in the sibling ecuador_2011_safety_safety). Options: the form prints aumentó ? 1 / se mantuvo igual ? 2 / disminuyó ? 3 / No sabe 8 / No responde 9 as completions of the stem (lower-case, space before ?, as printed); the .sav value labels read Aumento / Se mantuvo igual / Disminuyo / No sabe / No responde on the same codes 1/2/3/8/9. The do-file maps Aumento->1, Se mantuvo igual->2, Disminuyo->3 and drops 8/9, so IRW resp equals the form code. Route 9 by server-side GROUP BY (no export): live item x resp counts equal .sav counts in 6/6 cells (resp 1/2/3: I55 39532/63305/12455; I56 82747/28066/5071). Dropped No sabe/No responde: I55 2273/172, I56 1761/92, so per-item n differs (I55 115,292; I56 115,884). Live: 231,176 rows, 117,058 ids (of 117,737 .sav informants), 0 duplicate id-item. English _translated columns are machine translation by this project.
